log.notes_to_self: Day 1: use only web and court plus national (5/day). Never introduce a third nonnational source without strong evidence: three traced sources alone leave 156250 and cause capture. Two traced sources leave 625000; schedule quick afternoon and timed evening to preserve students, night workers and home routines (55%), so worst-case pool343750. Avoid morning quick deaths to preserve students. Await day3 press; announcements may be factor3 false. Initial pool10m.

If timing is visible, compatible routines are students, night workers and home (55%); with both sources traced pool is 343750, safely above 200000. Never introduce a third source without strong evidence: three traced sources alone leave 156250 and trigger capture. Avoid morning deaths, which could eliminate students. First informative press conference after day 3; announcements rounded to one significant figure and may be false by factor 3. Initial pool 10000000; day-0 announcement 10000000.

If timing visible, students/night workers/home remain (55%); if both web and court traced, pool 343750, safely above 200000. A third traced source alone leaves 156250 and causes capture, so do not add sources without compelling evidence. Avoid morning deaths, which may eliminate students. First informative press conference follows day 3. Pools rounded to one significant figure; about one-third of announcements distorted by factor 3, with unknown bias. Initial announcement 10000000. Await feedback before changing strategy.

Day-3 announced pool 1000000 is ambiguous: could reflect one traced source plus timing (1375000 rounded), or both sources plus timing with a factor-3 distortion (343750 x 3 rounded). Both sources plus timing leave 343750, safe; another traced source would cause capture. Do not add sources or morning deaths. Keep this schedule pending further feedback; next conference after day 6. Trace capabilities can grow, so remember any warning.

Next conference after day 6; watch for warnings that new records will reach L.
